A clean buffer refreshes with stable selection; a dirty buffer retains base/local/current representations. Disjoint qualified mappings reconcile through shared source preparation; duplicate/reordered updates and detach/reconnect never replace the live replica or silently submit stale full source.

Overlap, deleted targets, ambiguous mapping and incompatible epoch preserve base/local/current content without partial mutation. User-selected resolution is prepared against current revision; another remote change invalidates stale resolution safely. Cancel/export retains recoverable drafts.

Normal quit, startup/I/O failure and supported interrupt/suspend/resume paths dispose resources and restore terminal settings. Flush failure offers explicit recoverable exit behavior; restart recovers locally committed data, pending outbox and unresolved draft/conflict state without claiming remote durability.

Clean packaged-binary consumers can discover and run supported TUI targets without a sibling checkout. Help matches behavior, external-editor commands remain available, and supported terminal/OS/accessibility claims identify actual evidence rather than inferring it from PTY simulation.
CLI consumes immutable core service revisions with existing15 buffer/reconciliation/diff behavior preserved.

Visible code coloring and Markdown table formatting stay responsive, preserve source spelling outside edited ranges and handle UTF-16/grapheme conversions. Expose the qualified code-tools commands and document search through terminal controls where supported; bind relevant FND/IDE cases without claiming pointer/OS GUI parity.
User can attach/reference/list/export assets through host ports; terminal cards preserve embed data without claiming graphical rendering.
Auto mode obeys local-paste policy; private title/cache/activation rules match26 and offline source editing remains available.
Import/export accepts declared formats with loss reports, atomic save/stale-target protection and cancellation; PDF input is rejected as export-only.

alphaAuditRequirements.requirement: Independent table-cell edits and structural conflicts preserve data
Bounded checkpoint journal recovery beyond 4096 updates with fallback/outbox safety
Long-lived structural replay, retained anchors/history and disconnected peers
One durable current format and coherent installed APIs without legacy runtime readers
Lossless captured shared conversion across API ports
Safe extension conversion registration and advanced review/refusal
Generic same-parent insertion after a block subtree with one undo
Independent block-menu/reorder configuration and API/menu/slash/keyboard parity
Public installed API and extension recipes including menu-off use
All original full-suite/runtime/accessibility/resource and unchanged size caps
